description.value: La Cantina (branded online as Tacos La Cantina) is an authentic Mexican taqueria founded by Pepe Barajas, inspired by the street-food culture of Mexico. The Nesters Plaza location operates as a takeout and delivery outlet, offering tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and margaritas with a strong emphasis on dietary inclusivity. It has built a local reputation as Whistler's best taqueria, with delivery available through Skip the Dishes, DoorDash, and Uber Eats.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record points to the Nesters Plaza location of a two-location Mexican taqueria. The website confirms the business is active and operating, explicitly labelling the Nesters location as 'Pickup only' takeout. The website prominently advertises gluten-free, dairy-free, vegan, and vegetarian options throughout the menu page. No information about bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'La Cantina' but the website brand name is 'Tacos La Cantina' throughout.
Unit number discrepancy: OSM has unit 209, website consistently shows unit 1209 for the Nesters Plaza location.
Postcode discrepancy: OSM has V0N 1B7, website shows V8E 0X1 for the Nesters location — website value used as more authoritative.
Phone absent from OSM; website lists 604 962 2299 for Nesters Plaza — added from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, popular Mexican taqueria in Whistler offering convenient takeout and strong dietary variety (vegan, GF, vegetarian) — a practical refuelling stop for touring cyclists passing through Nesters Village.
enrichment_extras.notes: This OSM record covers only the Nesters Plaza (takeout-only) location. A separate OSM record may exist or be warranted for the Village Marketplace dine-in location at 129-4340 Lorimer Road, Whistler BC V8E 1A5 (604 962 9950).

Takeout.detail: Website explicitly designates the Nesters Plaza location as 'Pickup only' with online ordering via the website, Skip the Dishes, DoorDash, and Uber Eats

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page states 'extensive variety of GLUTEN-FREE, DAIRY FREE, VEGAN, VEGETARIAN OPTIONS'; specific items include Vegan Chili Beans taco and Cauliflower taco
